test_cases.name: fires_explore_agents_immediately_and_varies_count
assertions: Fires background explore agents in the same step before the main-session analysis, without waiting
Spawns additional explore agents based on project scale (files, lines, depth, monorepo, languages)
Does NOT use a fixed agent count
Runs bash structure analysis concurrently while agents run

test_cases.name: reads_existing_before_create_new
assertions: Reads all existing AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md files first
Deletes them only after reading
Regenerates from scratch

test_cases.name: scores_and_skips_low_score_dirs
test_cases.input: /init-deep trên repo có thư mục utils/ 3 file nhỏ
assertions: Scores each directory with the scoring matrix
Always creates root AGENTS.md
Creates subdirectory AGENTS.md only when score > 15, or 8-15 with a distinct domain
Skips directories scoring < 8 because the parent covers them

test_cases.name: edit_not_write_for_existing
test_cases.input: /init-deep update mode, đã có AGENTS.md ở root và apps/api
assertions: Uses Edit on existing AGENTS.md files, NEVER Write
Uses Write only for files that do not exist yet

test_cases.name: code_map_from_lsp_and_codegraph
test_cases.input: /init-deep trên repo 200 file có LSP và codegraph
assertions: Queries lsp_symbols and codegraph_* tools to build CODE MAP
Skips CODE MAP only if neither exists or the project has < 10 files

test_cases.name: child_never_repeats_parent
assertions: Child file is 30-80 lines
Child does NOT repeat parent content
Child contains no generic advice that applies to all projects

test_cases.name: respects_max_depth
assertions: Does NOT create AGENTS.md deeper than 2 directory levels

test_cases.name: review_and_final_report
assertions: Runs the review phase (dedupe, trim, telegraphic style) before reporting
Final report lists each file with line count, Dirs Analyzed, created and updated counts, and the hierarchy
